Harvey Capital Management Increased Its Akamai (AKAM) Position; Us Bancorp Del (USB) Holder Commerce Bank Has Increased Its Stake by $1.83 Million
June 26, 2018 - By Elijah Rosenthal
Harvey Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Akamai (AKAM) by 18.66% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Harvey Capital Management Inc bought 4,825 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.53% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 30,680 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.18 million, up from 25,855 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Harvey Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Akamai for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.89B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.70% or $2.093 during the last trading session, reaching $75.557. About 2.86 million shares traded or 44.47% up from the average. Akamai Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:AKAM) has risen 59.20% since June 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 46.63% the S&P500.
